name: Pinnacle Security Riot Helm MkIV
description:
Full-coverage riot helmet with integrated comm systems, a retractable face shield rated for blunt impact, and mounting rails for auxiliary equipment — cameras, flashlights, gas filters. The shell is ceramic-composite over a shock-absorbing foam core. The interior features adjustable padding and a three-point chin strap.

Standard issue for Pinnacle Security crowd-control units and licensed to several corponation internal security divisions. The MkIV's modular rail system means no two helmets in the field look identical — each operator customizes their loadout.
functionality: Full head protection, integrated comms, modular accessory mounting, retractable face shield
what_it_says: You're the one they send when the crowd stops listening to words.
story_hooks: A Pinnacle Riot Helm's onboard camera footage leaks, showing security forces using unauthorized force during a Shelf protest — but someone edited out the faces of the officers.
related_entities: ARCTURUS DEFENSE Bastion Subdermal Armor Mesh

physical_description.visual_profile: Aggressive, imposing full-coverage riot helmet with a pronounced angular forward rake. The retractable face shield creates a menacing slit-eyed appearance when deployed. Integrated rails create a tactical, modular silhouette with potential equipment clusters at temples and crown.
physical_description.fit: Snug, pressure-fit design with adjustable internal padding. Three-point chin strap sits firm against the jaw. Designed for stability during high-impact scenarios; sits low over the brow and back of skull.
physical_description.primary_material: Ceramic-composite shell over shock-absorbing polymer foam core. Rails are reinforced aluminum. Chin strap is synthetic grip-weave.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, slightly matte ceramic exterior with fine grid texture from composite layering. Interior padding is soft, moisture-wicking foam. Metal rails have subtle brushed finish.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep matte charcoal gray primary shell with gunmetal gray rail systems. Retractable shield tint is smoked amber-gray. Optional accents (decals, operator insignia) in high-visibility accent colors or corpo branding.
physical_description.closures: Three-point chin strap with friction-lock buckles. Shield retracts via servo mechanism (requires minimal hand pressure). No traditional zippers; tool-less rail-mounted accessories use quick-detach clips.
distinctive_features: Modular mounting rails (top, sides, rear) for cameras, flashlights, gas filters, or custom loadouts
Servo-powered retractable smoked polycarbonate face shield rated for blunt impact absorption
Internal comm-system integration port (flush-mounted at left temple)
Ventilation channels along sides to prevent fogging
Operator customization wear patterns — scratches, tape residue, unit markings
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1-2 corporate security issue. High-end industrial, locked behind licensed corp contracts.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by Pinnacle Security personnel, corporate internal security divisions, and authorized riot-control operators. Signals authority, crowd-control capacity, and corpo backing. Intimidating presence in any civilian space.
physical_description.condition_typical: Field-worn but well-maintained. Scuff marks on shell, tape residue where operator callsigns or unit patches were applied. Rail surfaces show mounting wear. Interior padding compressed from extended use. Possibly stained with sweat or dust from deployment.
